methods_quotes.q: Estimates were weighted to the age, race, and sex distribution of each state's population, and 95% confidence intervals were calculated by using SUDAAN.
The percentage of respondents who reported smoke-free workplace policies was calculated and reported by state and by respondents' education level.
A smoke-free policy was defined as a policy that did not permit smoking in the common, public, or work areas of the workplace.
Respondents who answered “don't know” or refused to answer either of the workplace smoking policy questions were excluded.
